name: Komehyo Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Komehyo Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the purchase, procurement, sale, brokerage, and auction of used and new products through stores in Japan, rest of Asia, the United States of America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Brand and Fashion Business, Tire and Wheel Business, and Real Estate Rental Business segments. The company offers jewelry, precious metals, watches, bags, fashion goods, clothing, kimonos, cameras, and musical instruments, as well as apparel and sneakers, and gemstones.
